title: Ten Winters and One Short Margin
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：essay　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 essay 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my aunt ① wrote an essay that no teacher in the school would have read, and she said the writing was the whole of the winter. The ② essay, meaning the paper itself and not the book, ran ten winters and stayed unread in the book; an essay, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unread.

Every ③ essay in that school had the same short margin beside it, and the ④ essay at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the prize and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An essay, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to read; my aunt said the reading is the part that fills ten winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the essay was the whole of the term, meaning the attempt and not the paper. The ⑥ essay, meaning the attempt and not any of that, is the only thing in a term that everybody waits for and nobody reads; essay, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a paper and an attempt. He said the attempt is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ essay had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short margin. The ⑧ essay of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one school and ten winters of reading; essay, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to read. She said the reading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ essay I remember is the one read in the list, which closed in 1963 and is still described as the quietest in the school. An ⑩ essay, my mother said in 1965, is the only one that improves by being read; every essay, she said, is an attempt that has agreed to look like a paper. She said the attempt was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文章；短文（指学校里每一篇旁边的那一篇）
B. n. 文章（指那一篇本身，与整本书相对）
C. 固定搭配：write an essay 写一篇文章
D. n. 文章（指留给评奖的那一篇）
E. n. 文章（抽象总称，指一所学校的习作之事）
F. n. 文章（指名单上写到、被登记的那一篇）
G. n. 尝试；努力之作（指学期里人人都等却无人阅读的那样东西）
H. n. 尝试（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人阅读的那样东西）

items.q: wrote an essay that no teacher in the school would have read
The essay, meaning the paper itself and not the book
the essay at the far side
the essay was the whole of the term
the essay had become a line in a list
The essay of the whole thing
An essay, my mother said in 1965

answers.why: write an essay 意为“写一篇文章”，1951 年姑姑写了一篇学校里没有一位老师肯读的文章。
essay 意为“文章”，指那一篇本身而不是整本书，它经过了十个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
essay 意为“文章”，指学校里每一篇旁边的那一篇，每一篇旁边都有同一道短短的页边空白。
essay 意为“文章”，指留给评奖的那一篇，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
essay 意为“尝试、努力之作”，指学期里人人都等却无人阅读的那样东西，叔叔说这篇习作就是那个学期的全部。
essay 意为“尝试”，指人人都等却无人阅读的那样东西而不是那一篇文章，是学期里人人都等、却无人阅读的东西。
essay 意为“文章”，指名单上写到、被登记的那一篇，到 1959 年这一篇成了名单里的一行。
essay 意为“文章”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的习作之事是一所学校和十个冬天的阅读。
essay 意为“文章”，我记得的是名单上登记的那一篇，1963 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一篇。
essay 为抽象总称，母亲 1965 年说，一篇文章是唯一会因为被好好阅读而变得更好的东西。
